release_read.basis: Q3 beat clearly on every line (revenue $343.6m vs $329.8m consensus, VMM $94.9m above the $88-93m guide, adj EBITDA $39.6m vs $34-36m) and FY EBITDA was raised to $151-153m from $145-152m, but the Q4 revenue guide of $315-325m sits about $20m below what the old FY guide implied, the FY revenue top was trimmed, and a $98.8m goodwill charge flags a weak segment; on a name sold on forward quality twice, that nets to a modest positive with wide uncertainty.

vs_bar.consensus_source: Nasdaq EPS forecast (brief fallback, 2 estimates); not like-for-like, GAAP includes a $98.8m non-cash goodwill charge; adjusted EPS not read

key_line.metric: Insurance segment revenue and the Q4 guide
key_line.detail: Insurance $234.9m, +15% YoY (peer-consistent beat, the thesis). Q4 guide revenue $315-325m, VMM $88-93m, adj EBITDA $34-36m: revenue mid ~$320m against ~$340m implied by the prior FY guide.

guidance.detail: FY adj EBITDA $151-153m (was $145-152m), VMM $370-375m (was $364-374m) raised; FY revenue $1.30-1.31bn (was $1.30-1.32bn) trimmed at the top, so the implied Q4 revenue is lowered. Mixed: profit raised, Q4 revenue soft.

call.detail: Call held last night; content not reviewed in the time available.

thesis_check.note: Insurance-led revenue beat and EBITDA beat as the peer read predicted; Q4 revenue guide and goodwill charge are the counterweight.

recommendation.reason: Voorlopig: de statische regel (amc, verkopen bij de opening) volgen.
